extracted.intended_audience: authors submitting material to Trident Media Group (writers seeking literary representation)
extracted.subtask_description: Terms and conditions that authors must accept before Trident Media Group will accept, consider, or evaluate submitted literary materials; legal and procedural requirements for submission and dispute handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acceptance conditional on agreement
rubrics_metrics.description: I acknowledge that in accordance with Trident’s established policy, Trident will not accept, consider or otherwise evaluate my material (collectively, my “Material”) until I agree to the following terms and conditions (collectively, these “Terms and Conditions”):
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submission will not be reviewed unless the author explicitly agrees to these Terms and Conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: No prior examination by Trident
rubrics_metrics.description: I acknowledge that Trident has not examined my Material prior to my review and acceptance of these Terms and Conditions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Author must accept that the agency has not pre-screened or vetted the material before agreement to terms.

rubrics_metrics.name: No obligation to review or represent
rubrics_metrics.description: I acknowledge that Trident has no obligation to review my Material or take me on as a client.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agreement does not create any duty on Trident’s part to evaluate submitted materials or offer representation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Representation of ownership and submission rights
rubrics_metrics.description: I represent that I am the sole owner of my Material and I have the full right to submit my Material to Trident.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Author warrants they hold necessary rights and authority to submit the work (no co-owners, third-party restrictions, or encumbrances).

rubrics_metrics.name: Governing law and forum selection
rubrics_metrics.description: I understand that these Terms and Conditions shall be construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York applicable to agreements executed and fully performed therein. I agree that any dispute, claim or controversy that may arise out my Material shall be resolved by a court of competent jurisdiction (state or federal) located in the State of New York, Borough of Manhattan, and I consent to the jurisdiction of such courts in connection therewith.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Any legal disputes are subject to New York law and must be brought in Manhattan courts; author consents to that jurisdiction.

rubrics_metrics.name: Severability of provisions
rubrics_metrics.description: If any provision of these Terms and Conditions is void or unenforceable, such provision shall be deemed omitted and the remainder of these Terms and Conditions shall remain in full force and effect.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a court invalidates part of the agreement, the rest remains binding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Entire agreement and written modification requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: I represent that I have read and understand these Terms and Conditions and that they reflect our entire understanding. Any modification or waiver to these Terms and Conditions must be approved in writing by Trident.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No verbal promises or side agreements are effective; changes require Trident's written approval.

rubrics_metrics.name: No entitlement to compensation for independently created similar material
rubrics_metrics.description: I understand that Trident has access to materials and ideas that may be similar to my Material in theme, idea, plot or format. I understand that I will not be entitled to compensation because of the use of any such similar or identical material if such material is created independently by Trident or its clients.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors waive claims for compensation where similarities arise from independent creation by the agency or its clients rather than from use of the submitted Material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Release of liability for loss or damage to submitted copies
rubrics_metrics.description: I hereby release Trident from any and all liability for loss of, or damage to, any copies of my Material that I may submit to Trident.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors assume risk of loss/damage to physical or electronic copies submitted; Trident disclaims responsibility.
